note: Allowlist row. Enable at least one allow row per field to CLOSE that dimension: with no enabled allow row for a field, the field is unconstrained.
The generalisation of the hand-wired Telegram allowlist: one row per admitted sender, editable without touching the cell.
Blocklist row. An explicit deny outranks every allow row.
Pattern row, case-folded substring match over the turn's text. A literal, never a regex.
Pattern row anchored at the beginning of the first turn.
